review_scope: Static and receipt/hash audit of the bounded Q4-grid-vs-Q8 H390 prediction diagnostic; no full prediction regrade, fit, upload, provider operation, or package mutation.

checks.hashes: PASS: the local Q4 ZIP, Q4 prediction array, Q8 source ZIP, callback receipt, Q8 prediction array, Q4 build receipt, and Q4 grade receipt match their pinned SHA-256 values.
checks.zip_integrity: PASS: `unzip -tq` reported no errors for the Q4 variant archive.
checks.precision_path: PASS: Q4 grading code explicitly constructs the same native EnsemblePredictor with precision='q8vnni' and checks model.precision == 'q8vnni' plus active_members == 2. The underlying Q8 callback receipt binds the exact source ZIP, native library, prediction array, and panel; its actual startup line reports precision=q8vnni. This is not an INT4 runtime.
checks.metric_and_mask: PASS: the grader calls the pinned GlobalAccumulator from src/wnn/gmetric.py (official metric global_wp_clip2_v1), uses need_prediction AND is_scored, and applies target clipping to [-2,2] with absolute clipped-target weights. It rejects any selected row in the first 99 warmup positions and checks sequence IDs and panel need-mask identity.
checks.row_count: PASS: per-sequence selected row counts sum to 15615, matching both scored accumulators and the prediction-fidelity summary.
checks.result_arithmetic: PASS: recomputing q4_wp - q8_wp from the receipt fields gives -0.0018012472395336765.
checks.no_regrade: PASS: reviewed the receipt, executable grader/build source, pinned output hashes, score arithmetic, and prediction-array metadata; did not rerun the full grade or load full predictions into memory.

interpretation.precision_choice: This panel supports retaining Q8 over the tested Q4-grid-rounded weights for this H390 pair when prediction quality is the priority.
interpretation.q4_definition: Selected dense matrices were rounded rowwise to signed levels -7..7, reconstructed and stored as float32 NPZ arrays, then evaluated through the unchanged Q8 VNNI backend. Build receipt expressly disclaims INT4 runtime and speed claims.
interpretation.exposure: The H390 checkpoints were fit on train+valid. These ten valid sequences are in-sample precision-fidelity evidence, not held-out CV, public-score, or generalization evidence.
interpretation.data_identity_limit: The full 5.6 GB valid.parquet was not hashed. The receipt pins file size/mtime plus selected sequence IDs, panel digest, feature hashes, need-mask hashes, and per-group target/mask hashes; it explicitly records full_valid_parquet_sha256 as null.
not_established: No general Q4-versus-Q8 effect across candidate families or folds.
No Q4 inference-speed benefit; both variants use the Q8 native runtime.
No public or held-out score forecast.
